title: LDAP filter built by concatenation (php) — review required
description: A php directory call assembles an LDAP filter from parts: ldap_search($c, $b, "(uid=$u)"). Filter metacharacters in untrusted input rewrite the query, bypassing authentication or dumping entries. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms escaping or parameterization.
remediation: Escape filter values with ldap_escape for filter values or use parameterized directory APIs.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled filter matches, including trusted ones.
